seo.title: LabWell — Snibe and Bio-Rad laboratory solutions
seo.description: LabWell is an official distributor of Snibe and Bio-Rad in Ukraine. Explore laboratory instruments, reagents and quality controls, with maintenance.

hero.h1: Snibe and Bio-Rad laboratory instruments, reagents and quality controls
hero.lead: LabWell is an official distributor of Snibe and Bio-Rad in Ukraine, offering solution selection, supply, installation, training, maintenance and application support.

snibe.description: Snibe manufactures instruments for clinical laboratories and in vitro diagnostic reagents.

bio-rad.description: Bio-Rad’s clinical diagnostics portfolio covers diabetes testing, immunohematology, autoimmunity and quality control.

contact.text: Tell us about your laboratory’s testing needs, and we will help you find a solution and answer your questions.

items.title: Solution selection
items.text: We help you select the most effective solution for your needs.

items.title: Installation and training
items.text: We install the instrument and train your staff to operate it.

items.title: Maintenance
items.text: We provide warranty and post-warranty maintenance.

items.title: Application support
items.text: A specialist advises on reagent performance, result interpretation and possible causes of erroneous results.
